meta.name: design-context
meta.description: Refresh UI/UX context from design system, Storybook, and codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从设计系统和代码库刷新UI/UX上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要保持设计与代码一致
copy.tagline_en: Refresh UI/UX context from design system and codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to keep design and code in sync

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会先读取设计系统文档，再查找Storybook组件故事，然后搜索代码库中类似模式，最后输出一个结构化的表格，列出设计系统、Storybook、代码库和库文档中相关的模式及可复用的组件与设计令牌。
howto.when: 在线框图阶段（DIVERGE模式）之前、实施UI更改之前，或每次DIVERGE循环时触发。用户也可手动用“use design-context skill”调用。

say.text: 帮我检查设计系统，列出这个线框图能用哪些组件。
say.note: Claude会执行全套流程并返回表格。

say.text: 在我改UI前，先运行design-context技能确保一致性。
say.note: Claude会检查现有模式并给出建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reads design system docs, finds Storybook stories, searches codebase for similar patterns, and outputs a structured table of relevant patterns and reusable components/tokens from design system, Storybook, codebase, and library docs.
howto.when_en: Before wireframing (Ask mode DIVERGE), before implementing UI changes (Agent mode), or at every DIVERGE loop. Can also be invoked manually with "use design-context skill".

say_en.text: Check the design system and list components usable for this wireframe.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full pipeline and returns a table.

say_en.text: Run design-context skill before I change the UI to ensure consistency.
say_en.note: Claude checks existing patterns and suggests applicable ones.
